scope: Read-only source/API review following stopped partial readiness-evo; no source, test, Simulator or build action.

wholeImageIndividuallyReviewed.observation: Preparing at00:10, board with bilateral red edges and both hands visible. This is not an active-Hang frame.

observedRun.causalLimit: This screenshot cannot identify which readiness preference/guard blocked startup; no per-host readiness telemetry in this review.

findings.source: Surface sets WorkoutRendererReadinessKey to pendingPreparation. Once ready that value is empty, while the child supplies the same key.
findings.interpretation: This is an explicit parent preference write where pass-through/merge is intended; it can mask descendant readiness. Apple documents preference as setting a value and transformPreference as modifying the existing value. Treat replacing it as correction of the composition contract, not proof it was the sole observed blocker.
findings.minimalCorrection: Use transformPreference and merge the Surface false record only for loading/unavailable. When ready leave incoming child value unchanged. Preserve false for unavailable and all request IDs. Do not set an empty preference at the ready parent.

findings.source: Board make adds root/camera then calls applySync; hands add root then sync/report. Reporting guards require scene membership inside those closures. There is no readiness attachment subscription; unchanged hands need not schedule a subsequent update after attachment.
findings.interpretation: The readiness latch depends on a later attachment state without a guaranteed observation event. Apple describes RealityView update as responding to view state changes, not a per-frame or guaranteed post-attachment notification. Exact nil membership at the failed make was not recorded, so this remains a source-supported failure path rather than a measured cause.
findings.minimalCorrection: Define this gate as completed CPU host configuration: actual make invoked content.add, then successful sync/fit at finite positive viewport. Remove Scene-membership checks from that preparation milestone; keep token/model/input signature matching, valid selection and asset availability. Both private board applySync call sites are actual make/update; hand report also follows make/update sync. No timer, forced camera invalidation, SceneEvents polling or redraw loop is required.

preserve: Request-generation and synchronized semantic/viewport/model identity keys; stale mismatches must still fail.
Unavailable content remains not ready. Do not convert load-ready alone into host-ready.
Original compile failure,22-frame stopped trial and its PENDING visual status remain untouched.
No GPU presentation or frame-completion claim from CPU make/sync. Existing three-second countdown can follow preparation, but whole first-Hang proof remains necessary.
The modelID addition addresses the prior same-input replacement concern; no source identity concern remains for that key.
minimalVerification: A hosted preference composition check should prove a ready child survives its ready Surface parent, while loading/unavailable contributes false. Pure gate dictionary tests do not exercise this.

Then fresh normal workflow must leave Preparing and show the full board and required hands at the earliest active checkpoint, followed by correct natural active/rest/next-active colors. Stalled22frames are no repair proof.

make configures content; optional update responds to view state. Per-frame work uses a separate mechanism.
